We used`Fold`from RNAstructure version 6.4 to generate thermodynamics predictions of the 95
sequences<sup>21</sup>. Each sequence was folded at 310.15 K (37 <sup>_◦_</sup>C) using the minimum-free-energy
structure. The rest of the parameters were default parameters. No DMS reactivities or base-pair

constraints were given to the RNAstructure. The predicted structures of each sequence were
converted to binary pairing matrix and evaluated with the same methodology described above.
